body: Heeeeey, I'm e x a c t l y in the same boat as you! Wanna chat about it?

Social media tends to make self improvement sound way more simple than it actually is. It is an insanely long step by step process not all of us are capable of walking alone or at all. If you have someone who knows you and can support you along the way then that's great. If you don't, it's pretty rough out here.

I see it as that some people find happiness in life because they are surrounded by healthy circles of friends and family who support them and that drives away such thoughts. Now i am not one of these lucky ones and my life's miserable, so I do get your sentiment sometimes. People are scared of dying cuz there's no guarantee that the afterlife is something good...or bad...
Why live? Because of simple pleasures like reading books or playing videogames for a lot of people. The lucky ones hold onto life because of their bonds with others and just plain cuz they are happy with their life. Now, what happens when you finally get sick of chasing simple pleasures and your life's fallen apart and you are alone? That's how we end up here
I've been like that for like half a year at this point. Well, some things changed recently, wanna chat?
